description: This file defines permissions logic for event types and workflows, including role-based and resource-based permission checks, with support for feature flag (PBAC) enabled/disabled states.

classes.name: ResourcePermissions
classes.description: Interface representing permissions for a resource, including read, create, update, and delete capabilities.

classes.name: EventTypePermissions
classes.description: Interface representing permissions for event types and workflows.

methods.name: createFullPermissions
methods.description: Creates an object with full permissions (all true) for event types and workflows.

methods.name: permissionsArrayToObject
methods.description: Converts an array of permission strings into a ResourcePermissions object based on resource and actions.

methods.name: getRoleBasedPermissions
methods.description: Returns permissions based on a user's role, with owner/admin/member distinctions.

methods.name: getHighestRole
methods.description: Determines the higher role between two roles based on hierarchy.

methods.name: getEventTypePermissions
methods.description: Main function to retrieve event type and workflow permissions for a user in a team, considering PBAC feature flag and role-based fallback.
